title: 半夜有人搭话：我是鬼，你呢

shots.image_prompt: a lone traveler seen from behind walking on a narrow dirt road at night in the countryside, holding a small paper lantern, a second dim figure walking beside him half hidden in mist, bare trees

lines.t: 半夜走夜路，身边多了一个人……

shots.image_prompt: wide shot of an empty rural road between dark fields under a moonless sky, a distant walled town barely visible, thin fog over the ground

lines.t: 南阳有个叫宋定伯的年轻人。

shots.image_prompt: low angle view of a muddy country road at night, two long shadows cast side by side by a lantern, one shadow solid, the other faint and blurred like smoke, straw sandals stepping

lines.t: 走着走着，旁边多了一串脚步声，

shots.image_prompt: side profile of a young man in Han dynasty clothing holding a lantern, looking sideways into darkness, a tall dark silhouette standing next to him in the mist, face not visible
a young man in Han dynasty clothing walking hunched forward on a dark road at night as if carrying a heavy load, a vague misty shape above his back, lantern swinging

lines.t: 鬼说，路远，咱们轮流背着走。
鬼背起他，说：你怎么这么沉？
他说：我是新死的，身子还重。

shots.image_prompt: view from behind of a man walking on a night road with a pale cloud of mist hovering close behind his head, his breath visible in the cold air

lines.t: 背上轻飘飘的，像背着一团雾，
凉气顺着后脖子往下走……

shots.image_prompt: two figures walking side by side at night seen from far behind, one solid with a lantern, the other a faint tall shadow, the road narrowing into darkness

lines.t: 他随口问：咱们做鬼的，最怕什么？

shots.image_prompt: a dark river at night with mist on the water, a man wading across with clothes rolled up, ripples around his legs, beside him a faint shadow crossing without any ripple

lines.t: 前面一条河。鬼过河，一点声音都没有。
鬼停下来问：你怎么有声音？

shots.image_prompt: a man standing on a riverbank at night, water dripping from his clothes, a tall shadow figure facing him in the mist, tense silence, faint first light at the horizon

lines.t: 他说：新死的，还不会过河，

shots.image_prompt: dawn over a misty rural market street in ancient China, a man in Han dynasty clothing holding a white sheep tightly with both arms, early villagers watching, blue-grey light

lines.t: 天快亮了，他一把将鬼扛上肩，死死按住。
落地的时候，变成了一只羊。

shots.image_prompt: a white sheep tied with a rope in a misty early morning market, people in Han dynasty clothes walking past, the sheep staring directly ahead, quiet and still

lines.t: 他朝羊身上吐了口唾沫，让它变不回去，
那天集上，没人知道自己买的是什么。

shots.image_prompt: an old empty country road at night disappearing into fog, a single paper lantern lying on the ground still glowing, no people
